race.comment: ISLAND MANDALAY (1) is in good form. Added to a string of top-four results when he finished third at his latest appearance at this circuit and distance, beaten 6 metres. Should get every chance from the inside draw so can break through. THE NINJA (8) was luckless last time but had some good form prior. Draws wide but can measure up with even luck. THRIPENNY (2) drops in grade on the last attempt. Form prior to that had been solid including a placing here two back and she should enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. COOINDALAI (9) didn't do a bad job when fourth here last time out and draws to trail the top pick.
